client.business_model: Multi-site, physician-led dermatology practice network providing medical, surgical, and cosmetic dermatology care across New England
client.client_history: Founded in 1992 by Dr. Samuel Goos as a solo practice, APDerm has expanded through acquisitions into a leading dermatology platform in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Rhode Island. The company emphasizes a collegial provider culture and supports clinicians with centralized practice management.

revenue.notes: Estimates range widely—LeadIQ $2.7 M, Growjo $44.7 M, Seamless.ai $1-5 M—with no confirmation from company or regulatory filings, so revenue is left as null.

locations.source: Oysterlink company profile citing “over 40 locations”; corroborated by multiple individual location pages on APDerm.com
locations.notes: Company website lists numerous locations in MA, NH, and RI; no single definitive count published but several sources state 40+.

employees.source: Indeed company profile (range 501-1,000) and LeadIQ estimate (501 employees)
employees.notes: Public sources vary from 105 to 501-1,000 employees. Using midpoint of the most frequently cited upper-tier estimates (~500). No official headcount disclosed.

extraction_sources: providenthp.com article on Waud Capital investment (Oct 2017)
extraction_notes: Official legal name confirmed in signed services agreement (“Adult & Pediatric Dermatology, PC”).
Private-equity backing by Waud Capital Partners confirmed in Provident Healthcare Partners article and APDerm/Treya case study.
Revenue figures conflict widely across estimation sites with no authoritative confirmation; therefore reported as null with low confidence.
Employee headcount varies significantly; most recent high-end estimates cluster around 500+, but confidence remains low.
Location count of ~40 taken from third-party profile and supported by manual count of website’s locations pages.
